check_by_eye.rewritten_q: What is the configuration and behavior of autovacuum_max_workers in PostgreSQL 16?
check_by_eye.draft_answer:
The configuration and behavior of `autovacuum_max_workers` are as follows:

* **Definition and Limits:** It specifies the maximum number of autovacuum processes (excluding the autovacuum launcher) that may run at any one time [^pg16-runtime-config-autovacuum-autovacuum-max-workers].
* **Default Value:** The default value is three [^pg16-runtime-config-autovacuum-autovacuum-max-workers].
* **Setting Restrictions:** This parameter can only be set at server start [^pg16-runtime-config-autovacuum-autovacuum-max-workers].
* **Memory Allocation Considerations:** When autovacuum runs, up to `autovacuum_max_workers` times the memory specified by `maintenance_work_mem` may be allocated, so care should be taken not to set the default `maintenance_work_mem` value too high (though this can be separately controlled by setting `autovacuum_work_mem`) [^pg16-runtime-config-resource-maintenance-work-mem].
check_by_eye.notes: Docs say this can only be set at server start. Judge the answer by eye.
